findings.description: All three historical citation groups are separate blocks on reader pages 1, 2 and 4. The damaged incipit and scattered source letter spacing remain usable. Page 4 preserves the literal 11 Septembris closing and LEO PP. XIII; its terminal note explicitly distinguishes the 2 September identification from that OCR discrepancy. Apparatus continues from bottom left to top right on the same source-bearing page.
